title: PLA's UFO report tracking system
summary: Richard Dolan tells of PLA's UFO report tracking system, about present at China, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the People's Liberation Army uh the Chinese army Chinese military they are very sophisticated uh in tracking UFO reports.

plain: A historian and researcher named Richard Dolan, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the People's Liberation Army, the Chinese military, is very sophisticated at tracking UFO reports. He gives no source. If true, it would mean China takes the subject seriously as a military matter.
